accrual_end_age.description: The age of the Participant when accrual of this Coverage ends.

accrual_ends_at.description: The date at which accrual of this Coverage ends.

accrual_start_age.description: The age of the participant when accrual of this Coverage starts.

accrual_started_at.description: The date at which accrual of this Coverage starts.

accrued_amount.description: The total amount that is accrued for this Coverage.

accrued_risk_amount.description: The built up risk amount for administering a coverage with a Risk calculation base.

accrued_years.description: The number of years that this Coverage has been accruing.

accrued_years_before_migration.description: The number of years that this Coverage has been accruing before migration.

age_difference_factor.description: The factor that the disbursement will be cut due to the age difference between the participant and beneficiary.

attainable_years.description: The total number of years that the Coverage will be building up, up to the `accrual_end_age`.

beneficiary_person_id.description: The Id of the Person that is the beneficiary of this Coverage.

converted_amount.description: The amount that has been deducted from the `accrued_amount` due to conversion (e.g., after divorce).

coverage_id.description: The unique internal Id of the Coverage within the Pension Administration.

cumulative_disbursement.description: The cumulative amount of what has been disbursed

deduction_amount.description: The amount that is deducted from the `accrued_amount`.

deduction_end_date.description: The end date amount that is deducted from the `accrued_amount`.

divergent_annual_salary.description: The divergent annual salary used for calculating this coverage.

divergent_salary_amount.description: The divergent salary used for calculating this coverage.

dossier_id.description: The Dossier Id in which the Policy to which this coverage belongs resides.

employer_annual_premium.description: The annual premium paid by the Employer.

employer_cumulative_premium.description: The total amount of premium paid by the Employer.

employer_premium_factor.description: The factor with regards to the `premium_base` that is paid by the Employer.

employer_waiver_annual_premium.description: The waivered annual premium that should have been paid by the Employer.

employer_waiver_cumulative_premium.description: The total waivered amount of premium that should have been paid by the Employer.

exempted_cumulative_premium.description: The amount of premium that the participant would have paid if she wasn't incapacitated.

expiration_age.description: The age of the beneficiary at the Coverage's `disbursement_stops_at`.

expiration_age_beneficiary.description: The age of the beneficiary at which the disbursement of the Coverage is expected to expire.

expiration_date.description: The date at which the `state` of the Coverage is expected to change to `NO_RIGHT`.

expiration_date_beneficiary.description: The date at which the disbursement of the Coverage is expected to stop, related to the beneficiary.

extra_amount.description: The amount that is added to the `accrued_amount`.

extra_salary.description: Additional salary, not included in the `pension_salary`.

ignore_maximum_salary_increase_factor.description: Ignore the maximum salary increase factor.

is_divergent_salary.description: Indicates whether this Coverage uses a pension salary that differs from the Policy's `pension_salary`.

is_double_payment.description: Indicates whether the payment is doubled.

is_participant_choice_received.description: Indicates whether the participant's choice concerning this coverage is received.

is_participating.description: Defines if the coverage applies to this Policy.

liability_capital.description: Amount of the coverage that is considered as liability capital.

missed_indexation_amount.description: The amount that is missed of the indexation of the accrued amount.

one_off_cumulative_premium.description: The cumulative of one-off premiums that have been deposited in this Coverage.

one_off_extra_savings_range.description: The available range for one-off additional savings.

one_off_extra_savings_range_premium.description: The premium that should be deposited to fully utilize `one_off_extra_savings_range`.

one_off_pension_salary.description: The salary that is used to calculate `one_off_extra_savings_range`.

one_off_used_pension_salary.description: The salary that was used for the one-off extra savings premium deposit.

paid_amount.description: The cumulative amount that has been disbursed for this Coverage.

participant_annual_premium.description: The annual premium paid by the Participant.

participant_cumulative_premium.description: The total amount of premium paid by the Participant.

participant_premium_factor.description: The factor with regards to the `premium_base` that is paid by the Participant.

participant_waiver_premium_factor.description: The factor with regards to the `premium_base` that is paid by the Participant.

paying_amount.description: The annual amount that is currently disbursed from this Coverage.

payment_reduction_factor.description: The factor that will cut the disbursement for this Coverage.

pension_accrual_factor.description: The factor in which pension is built up.

pension_age.description: The age of the beneficiary at the Coverage's `disbursement_starts_at`.

pension_age_beneficiary.description: The age of the beneficiary at which the disbursement of the Coverage is expected to start.

pension_base.description: The amount on which the calculated Coverage is based.

pension_date.description: The date at which the `state` of the Coverage is expected to become `COMMENCED`.

pension_date_beneficiary.description: The date at which the disbursement of the Coverage is expected to start for the beneficiary.

pension_salary.description: The annual pension salary used for calculating this Coverage.

policy_id.description: The Policy Id of the Policy to which this coverage belongs.

premium_base.description: The amount that is the bases for the Premium calculation.

premium_reduction_factor.description: The reduction on the calculated premium.

product_component_name.description: The name of the Product Component on which this Coverage is based.

projected_amount.description: The attainable amount that would be accrued on the `accrual_end_age` with non-changing conditions.

prospective_years.description: The number of years that the Coverage will be building up in the future.

rated_accrued_years.description: The number of years that this Coverage has been accruing, rated according to the `years_accrual_factor` of this Coverage's Policy.

rated_attainable_years.description: The rated (according on the `years_accrual_factor`) total number of years that the Coverage will be building up, up to the `accrual_end_age`.

smoothing_capital.description: Amount of the coverage that is considered as smoothing capital.

waiver_annual_premium.description: The annual premium based on the `waiver_premium_factor`.

waiver_cumulative_premium.description: The amount of paid waiver premium.

waiver_premium_factor.description: The factor for a premium that is paid for insurance of premium waiver of this Coverage.
